title: Manual TLS certificate renewal for edge listeners
summary: Four edge listeners hold certificates issued by an external authority that the platform does not integrate with. Each renewal means raising a request with the authority, waiting for issuance, uploading the chain to the certificate store, updating the listener reference and confirming the new chain serves correctly from outside the network.

frequency.source: change-record query: edge listener certificate updates
frequency.notes: One renewal per listener. Occurrence count tracks listener count, so onboarding a region adds an occurrence rather than lengthening an existing one.

cost.source: time-tracking entries against the certificate renewal change records
